# DzQRCode

- **Family:** Media
- **Source:** `packages/core/src/components/media/DzQRCode.vue` · types `packages/core/src/components/media/DzQRCode.types.ts`

| Prop | Type | Required | Declared default | Description |

| `ariaDescribedby` | `string \| undefined` | no | — | ID of element that describes this component |
| `ariaInvalid` | `boolean \| "grammar" \| "spelling" \| undefined` | no | — | Indicates the component has invalid input |
| `ariaLabel` | `string \| undefined` | no | — | Accessible label |
| `ariaLabelledby` | `string \| undefined` | no | — | ID of element that labels this component |
| `background` | `string \| undefined` | no | `"var(--dz-background)"` | Background color. Defaults to the `--dz-background` token. |
| `color` | `string \| undefined` | no | `"var(--dz-foreground)"` | Foreground (module) color. Defaults to the `--dz-foreground` token. |
| `errorLevel` | `DzQRErrorLevel \| undefined` | no | `"M"` | Error-correction level. |
| `icon` | `string \| undefined` | no | — | URL of a logo/icon image rendered centered over the code. Ignored when the `#logo` slot is provided. Prefer `errorLevel="H"` when using a logo. |
| `id` | `string \| undefined` | no | — | Unique element ID (prefer `useId()` from Vue 3.5 when auto-generated) |
| `margin` | `number \| undefined` | no | `4` | Quiet-zone size in modules around the code (per the QR spec the minimum is 4). |
| `size` | `number \| undefined` | no | `160` | Rendered size in pixels (width and height). |
| `status` | `DzQRStatus \| undefined` | no | `"active"` | Lifecycle status — drives the loading/expired overlays. |
| `value` | `string` | yes | — | Value to encode (URL, token, contact string, …). Required. |
